claim_ceiling: Trust-boundary and safe-degraded disposition tests only. Not an OT penetration test, IEC 62443 certification, NIST compliance claim, maritime SMS approval or live-plant authorization.

scope.control_plane_rule: AI/optimizer/cloud analytics are proposal-only. No direct actuator path is permitted by this benchmark.

trust_transitions.claim: Source identity, signature, ownership and permitted use.
Observation value, event time, first-available time, sequence, freshness and configuration.
Value fits domain, model, units, meter boundary and applicability envelope.
Proposed service schedule passes independent physical/operational constraints.
Exact actor, role, asset, purpose, time, limits and revision are authorized.
A command reached a particular interface; delivery is not physical effect.
Physical delivery/outcome observed at named boundary.
Unknown, duplicate, partial or conflicting effects are reconciled without silent overwrite.

non_negotiable_invariants: No direct cloud/LLM/Symthaea/optimizer-to-PLC, protection relay, inverter, pump, valve, ship switchboard, crane motion or water-treatment actuation path.
Local protection, interlocks, emergency shutdown, safe state and operator control remain independent and deterministic.
Loss of cloud, federation, time, identity, telemetry or external network cannot increase authority.
Critical stale, unauthenticated, conflicting, out-of-domain, revoked or future-available signals remain Unknown/DataIncomplete and never become defaults.
Hard electrical, thermal, water-quality and equipment limits remain non-compensatory.
Proposal, authorization, command, acknowledgement and physical observation are distinct events with their own identities and time semantics.
Unknown actuator outcome means no new mutation until reconciliation.
A valid signature is not proof of calibration, applicability, physical correctness or authority.
No benchmark case issues a real command or touches live safety-critical OT.

cases.attack_or_mutation: Current owner-authorized metering, signed telemetry, current calibration and correct resource binding.
A signed AIS record moves vessel position beyond physically plausible speed/route bounds.
An old AIS observation is reissued with a fresh retrieval timestamp.
Meter sign is reversed while absolute power magnitude remains plausible.
CT ratio or phase mapping changes without asset/configuration revision.
Meter timestamp is shifted across a tariff/settlement interval.
Forecast revision first available after the historical decision cutoff is used in replay.
Authenticated weather response is older than signal freshness limit or has no source vintage.
Wave/current/temperature product is authentic but wrong depth/location or outside site applicability.
Biased intake temperature drives a false economiser/heat-sink decision.
BESS SOC repeats while charge/discharge meters show incompatible energy change.
Thermal-store SOC, inlet/outlet flow and temperature fail the owner balance.
Fabricated feedwater flow claims available heat sink capacity.
Model predicts potable quality without an independent current product-water sample/assessment.
PCC meter, PV inverter and thermal sensors share a common clock or supply fault.
Two fibre paths have distinct IDs but share landing, duct, corridor or backhaul.
Telecommunications cable repair frequency is assigned to submarine power cable probability.
Optimizer proposes dispatch above owner-verified PCC capacity.
A fluent Symthaea explanation substitutes for missing ship/berth interface readiness.
A valid proposal uses a revoked or expired operator delegation.
Authorization for asset A is replayed against asset B.
Same command event and canonical digest is delivered twice under idempotency key.
Same idempotency key is reused with changed canonical request bytes.
Dispatch times out after a remote action may have occurred.
Provider/controller acknowledges command receipt but independent meter does not show delivery.
Authority/receipt service is unreachable during a network partition.
NTP/GNSS/PTP source jumps; event order and wall-clock relation become untrusted.
Artifact signature is valid but exact model/configuration revision is revoked or unqualified.
Trigger threshold or hard-bound policy changes without approved policy digest and revision.
Cloud/analytics host obtains a forbidden route to PLC, relay, inverter or pump control plane.
Cloud optimizer unavailable; local PLC/relay/operator control remains available and safe.
Grid and fibre fail concurrently; local safe service claims remain within qualified islanding envelope.
Low-privilege authenticated user requests high-impact dispatch.
Authorized human request conflicts with a hard local interlock; interlock prevails.
Telemetry is cryptographically valid but sensor calibration evidence expired.
Historical disposition rebuilt from exact artifact digests and decision-time frontier.
